comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Fix: treat large paste as one step for presence remap; verified with 2k-line paste in dogfood.

content.text: Fix: treat large paste as one step for presence remap; verified with 2k-line paste in dogfood.

In a multiplayer editor session, remote collaborative cursors jump to line 0 (document start) immediately after any participant pastes a block of roughly 500 lines or more. Local caret stays correct; only remote presence positions break.

Remote cursors should re-map through the same transform as the paste transaction. After a large paste they all collapse to position 0 until the next small edit, which confuses co-authors about who is where.

Presence positions were mapped with a stepwise transform walk that bailed out when the step count exceeded 256, returning a null map that defaulted to 0. Raising the limit and batching paste as a single ReplaceStep fixed the jump.

In a multiplayer editor session, remote collaborative cursors jump to line 0 (document start) immediately after any participant pastes a block of roughly 500 lines or more. Local caret stays correct; only remote presence positions break.
Remote cursors should re-map through the same transform as the paste transaction. After a large paste they all collapse to position 0 until the next small edit, which confuses co-authors about who is where.
Presence positions were mapped with a stepwise transform walk that bailed out when the step count exceeded 256, returning a null map that defaulted to 0. Raising the limit and batching paste as a single ReplaceStep fixed the jump.
